name: Hidden ~Himerareta Yokubou~
source:
Main character got a part-time job at the SM bar. Soon he got interested in SM under influence of the mistress Rie. There are three girls for training, each able to become either M or S. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一家SM酒吧找到兼职工作。不久后，在女王莉惠的影响下，他开始对SM产生兴趣。这里有三名可供调教的女性，每个人都能被培养成M或S。
